gloss.en: The root قطمر (qTmr) refers to the thin skin or cleft of a date-stone, or the small white point from which a palm tree grows. It metaphorically signifies something small, mean, or paltry.
gloss.short: The root قطمر (qTmr) refers to the thin skin or cleft of a date-stone, or the small white point from which a palm tree grows.
